newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms buy 49,150 tonnes of Thai tapioca.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms buy 49,150 tonnes of Thai tapioca.

text.p: A South Korean feed grain buyer group, known as the Feed Buying Group, bought 49,150 tonnes of Thai tapioca at $83.89 a tonne C&F, traders said on Monday.
They said the buyer group made the purchase from Soon Hwa Seng on Saturday through a closed tender.

They said the purchase was split into four lots: the first for 11,100 tonnes for arrival by May 10, the second for 13,600 tonnes for arrival by June 10, the third for 13,450 tonnes for arrival by July 10 and the last for 11,000 tonnes for arrival by September 10 at the western port of Inchon.
